    Jack finished a 16 km race in 53 min 15 sec.

sourceReview.excerpt:
Mastery

9.  Tom was 120 cm tall when he turned 10 years old.\
    He was 185 cm tall when he turned 20 years old.\
    Find Tom's average rate of growth per year between 10 and 20 years
    of age.

Growth = 185 - 120 = 65 cm

Time = 20 - 10 = 10 years

Average rate = 65÷10= 6.5 cm / year

10. The temperature was 20${^\circ}$C at 9 am. At noon the temperature
    had risen to 32${^\circ}$C.\
    What was the average increase in temperature per hour?

Temperature increase = 32 - 20 = 12°C

Time = 12 - 9 = 3 hours

Average increase = 12/3 = 4°C / hour

11. The Burwood Football Club had 12 000 members.\
    After five successful years, they now have 18 000 members.\
    What has been the average rate of membership growth per year for the
    past 5 years?

Membership increase = 18000 - 12000 = 6000 members

Time = 5 years

Average rate = 6000/5 = 1200 members / year

12. A car had a full tank of 56 L at the start of a 75 km journey.\
    At the end of the journey, the fuel tank was three quarters full.\
    What is the fuel consumption rate, in kilometres per litre?

Fuel consumed = 56 - (3/4)(56) = 56 - 42 = 14 L

Fuel consumption rate = 75/14 = 75/14 ≈ 5.36 km / litre
